literal_meaning: তিল (sesame) + উত্তমা (excellent); a mythical apsara's name from Hindu lore
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এমন তিলোত্তমা যে সবাই তার প্রতি মুগ্ধ।
example_sentences_in_english: She is such a Tilotamma that everyone is enchanted by her.
The story's heroine was a Tilotamma.
history: Tilotamma is an apsara from Hindu Puranas, created by the gods to distract the asuras Sunda and Upasunda, leading to their mutual destruction due to their infatuation with her.
note: Derived from Sanskrit mythology, commonly used in Bengali to denote unparalleled female beauty.
